<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="exX0042026-03-0409-49-12" status="unreviewed">
              gnyis pa dngos po kho na mtshan gzhir 'dod pa dgag pa ni chan sgrub bya'i mtshan gzhi ni <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:unnamed_reference" ref="db:3780">kha 1</rs>
               <note type="gloss"><rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3780">chos mchog</rs></note><note type="editorial">or "phya pa" (written above), as chos mchog could be deleted</note> bsgrub bya'i mtshan gzhi ni la me ldan sgra mi rtag pa'i dngos po yin gyis sgra rtag par dam bcas pa ni sgrub bya skyon can skyon med gang du yang gzhag du Na de tshogs don mi srid s pa'i phyir ro zhes zer ro || de mi 'thad pa ni 
               
               de ltar na mig lasogs
               <lb n="125b5"/>pa'i lta'i ngo'i bdag gi don byed par 'dod pa 'di sgrub bya ma yin par 'gyur te | <note type="gloss"><rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:">dan</rs></note>tshigs don la mi gnas pa'i phyir ri rtags tshad ma khyab pa khas blangs 'dod na de dpe' la Na pa dpe' chos kyis stong pa dang der rtags kyis bkag pa 'gal ba ma yin par thal ba las gzhung nas de ltar 'chad pas bsal ba yin no || </seg></TEI>
